messages:
max: Ok team, quick sync — I pushed the release notes draft for v1.9.0 to the doc. Need a short internal blurb and pin slot for 10:00 UTC window.
kelly: On it. I'll trim the blurb to a concise 2-sentence summary. Is the fallback model variant note still required?
anya: Yes please keep the fallback note. Ops wants the exact pin time and rollback owner in the blurb.
darren: FYI deploy-bot shows the canary window as 10:00-10:30 UTC and full rollout 10:45-11:30 UTC. Can we avoid overlapping with the infra maintenance at 11:00?
max: Good catch. Let's move full rollout to start at 11:30 then. That gives a 30m buffer. Kelly, include that timing.
kelly: Draft blurb: "v1.9.0 deploy (11:30 UTC full rollout, canary 10:00 UTC). Includes routing policy fixes and batching improvements. Fall back to v1.8.x variant if latency regressions >15%. Rollback lead: @darren, oncall handoff to @ops-oncall." Thoughts? :thumbsup:
anya: Looks good. Maybe add a single-line note about release notes location and reviewers: "See doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/v1.9.0 (Max)"
darren: Fine. For rollback criteria, add: "If error rate increases by >1% for 10 minutes or top-end latency P95 regresses >200ms, rollback."
kelly: Updated message w/ rollback metrics. Also added the pin request: "Please pin at 09:55 UTC for staff digest."
max: I'm going to request the pin in #eng-releases at 09:55 and schedule the internal announcement. Any objections to the wording?
anya: One tiny nit: change "routing policy fixes" -> "smart-routing fixes (policy-based fallback)". More descriptive.
darren: Approve. Also: when we trigger rollback, which deployment tag do we pin back to? Use the digest tag v1.8.7-rc2?
max: Yes, we'll pin to v1.8.7-rc2 for fast revert. Add that to the notes.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start=2026-09-12T10:00:00Z, canary_end=2026-09-12T10:30:00Z, rollout_start=2026-09-12T11:30:00Z, rollout_end=2026-09-12T12:30:00Z. Trigger channel: #eng-releases.
ops-oncall: Noted. I'll be on standby at 11:15 UTC for the handover to Darren. If anything looks off before that, ping me.
kelly: Final blurb ready, pushing to the internal announce doc now and requesting pin at 09:55 UTC. Copy: "Heads-up: v1.9.0 rollout — canary 10:00 UTC, full 11:30 UTC. Smart-routing fixes and batching improvements. Rollback to v1.8.7-rc2 if error rate +1% (10m) or P95 +200ms. Rollback lead: @darren, ops backup: @ops-oncall. Pin request 09:55 UTC."
max: Perfect. I'm adding a short checklist to the notes: 1) Confirm pin 09:55, 2) QA smoke pass at 10:10, 3) Canary metrics OK at 10:25, 4) Gate to rollout at 11:15.
anya: Added links to the dashboards and the exact query strings to the doc (see section "Canary checks").
darren: I'll be ready. If rollback triggers, I'll call the rollback playbook and post the status in this thread.
kelly: Pin requested. Tagging @eng-team for visibility.
max: Thanks all. Closing the loop: I'll post final internal announcement at 09:58 UTC, and then we'll watch deploy-bot updates here. :rocket:
